title: Kinds of sins – small sins
intro: A sin is anything Allah forbade. Small sins must not be taken lightly.

learn.title: 📖 In the Qur’an
learn.html: Luqman told his son: O my son, even if a deed – good or bad – were the weight of a mustard seed, inside a rock, in the heavens or in the earth, Allah will bring it out. Allah is Subtle, All-Aware. <small>(Qur’an, Luqman 31:16)</small>

A sin is anything Allah has forbidden, crossing His limits, and neglecting the Islamic duties. Sins differ in how harmful and how big they are. Sins can be public or secret; visible – done with the hands, feet and so on – or invisible – done with the heart, like hatred, envy or insincerity. There are sins against Allah and sins against His creatures.
Sins are divided into small, major and serious sins.

learn.title: Small sins
learn.html: Small sins are those with no set punishment in the Shari‘ah and no open threat of Jahannam. But if someone keeps doing small sins and thinks they don’t matter, that becomes a major sin.

items: talking while the adhan or iqamah is being called
missing the prayer in jama‘ah without a good reason
talking while the Qur’an is being recited
facing the Qiblah when using the toilet
ignoring a Muslim without a reason

learn.title: Hadith
learn.html: The Prophet (SAW) said: “There is no small sin that will not grow into a major one if it is taken lightly, and no major sin that tawbah and asking forgiveness will not turn into a small one.” (Daylami)

learn.title: ⭐ Remember
learn.html: Small sins can be wiped away by tawbah or by good deeds. Small sins are the road to major ones – so we must not do them, even though they have no set punishment.
